The Science
What is Dermapen 4?

Dermapen 4 is the world's most advanced FDA-approved microneedling device â often called the 'Rolls-Royce of microneedling pens.' It uses 16 ultra-fine needles with precision oscillating technology to create thousands of controlled micro-channels in the skin, triggering your body's natural collagen and elastin production.

Unlike traditional dermarollers or basic microneedling devices, Dermapen 4 offers adjustable needle depth (up to 3mm), vertical stamping action (no micro-tears), and an inbuilt Scar Treatment Setting. This means safer, more precise, and dramatically better results for every skin concern.

Available at ISAAC Luxe, Dermapen 4 treats everything from acne scars and wrinkles to pigmentation, stretch marks, and enlarged pores. It also enhances the absorption of serums and growth factors by up to 80%, making every active ingredient work harder for your skin.

Precision Microneedling
How Does It Work?

Oscillating Needle Technology

16 ultra-fine needles create thousands of micro-channels per second using a vertical stamping action. This is far superior to dermarollers (which drag and tear skin). Adjustable depth from 0.25mm to 3mm allows customized treatment for every concern and skin area.

Collagen Induction Therapy

The controlled micro-injuries trigger your body's natural wound-healing cascade â producing new collagen, elastin, and growth factors. The micro-channels also increase absorption of serums by up to 80%, supercharging every active ingredient applied during treatment.

Your Questions Answered
Frequently Asked Questions

Does Dermapen 4 hurt?

With topical numbing cream applied 20â30 minutes before, the procedure is very comfortable. Most clients feel a mild vibrating sensation. The vertical stamping action is gentler than dermarollers.

How soon will I see results?

Some patients feel improvements immediately after the first session â increased muscle firmness and toning. Visible fat reduction typically appears 2â4 weeks after completing all 4 sessions, with optimal results at 2â3 months as fat cells are naturally eliminated.

Is it safe for Indian skin?

Absolutely! Unlike lasers that carry pigmentation risks for darker skin, Dermapen 4 is 100% safe for all skin types. No heat or light energy â just mechanical micro-channels that heal perfectly.

Can I combine it with other treatments?

Yes! Emsculpt NEO pairs excellently with treatments like CoolSculpting, Exilis Elite, and lymphatic drainage. Our experts at ISAAC Luxe can design a comprehensive body contouring plan tailored to your goals.

How many sessions for acne scars?

Mild scars: 3 sessions. Moderate scars: 4â5 sessions. Deep/severe scars: 6+ sessions. The inbuilt Scar Treatment Setting auto-calibrates depth up to 3mm for optimal scar treatment.

What's the downtime?

24â48 hours of redness (like a mild sunburn). Some clients experience mild flaking at day 3â4. Most return to work the next day with SPF. No heavy makeup for 24 hours.
